Yes, this all-or-nothing handling is exactly what I'd expect. When I saved with "not a web address" in the address field, the panel stayed open, it showed a clear message telling me to enter a complete address and — importantly — that nothing had been saved yet. Everything I'd typed stayed put: my "Changed title," the description, any label I'd added, all still sitting in the panel waiting for me to fix the one problem. And the actual bookmark card behind it didn't budge — still the old title and old address, not half-changed. Then once I put in a proper address and saved, all my edits landed together in one go.

That's the right behavior. The thing I'd hate is a half-applied save — where my title change went through but the bad address got rejected, leaving the bookmark in some in-between state I didn't intend. Either the whole set of edits applies or none of it does, and while I'm fixing the mistake nothing I typed gets thrown away and nothing on the real card changes. This handles it just that way. Good.
